correctness.rationale: Aubry–Perret equality for geometric genus one and arithmetic genus two forces normalization maximal and a single rational nonsplit node with degree-two preimage, giving a unique pinched degree-two closed point. Over F_(p²), maximal E has Frobenius [-p], and E(F_(p^4))=E[p²-1]. Differences F(Q)-Q=-(p+1)Q cover E[p-1]\{0}; translations by E(F_(p²)) identify fibers and swapping the conjugate points identifies D with -D. Since -1 belongs to the origin-fixing group G (order m), unpointed curves correspond to G-orbits. Curve stabilizers have size 2|G_D|, including when D=-D by counting the two translations. Burnside on (Z/(p-1))² gives m2 (n²+2)/2 orbits, m4 (n²+4)/4, m6 (n²+2)/6, with aut orders 2/4/8 exactly as stated. Independent group action enumeration checked 10 (p,m) samples including exceptional j values; the infinite result is the torsion/Burnside argument.
